label: schema-140-found-secrets
prompt: Write ONLY PostgreSQL DDL (no markdown) for 06_SCHEMA/140_found_secrets.sql. Schema: lucidota_vault. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS found_secret: secret_uuid uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), found_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), found_by text NOT NULL (which script/worker found it), source_path text NOT NULL (file or URL where found), secret_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(secret_kind IN ('api_key','token','password','private_key','connection_string','certificate','other')), secret_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(secret_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') (sha256 of raw secret for dedup, never the secret itself in plain), context_snippet text (surrounding text with secret redacted as [REDACTED]), work_description text (what job/operation was running), work_uuid uuid (FK to absurd_queue_job if applicable), source_corpse_uuid uuid REFERENCES lucidota_control.corpse_event(corpse_uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL, operator_reviewed boolean DEFAULT false, operator_notes text, detail jsonb DEFAULT '{}', UNIQUE(secret_hash). Comment header: SECRETS ARE TREASURE. Every secret found by any worker is saved here with provenance. Never disclosed. Never discarded. Operator reviews for rotation/revocation.

label: schema-update-corpse-found-secret
prompt: Write ONLY PostgreSQL DDL (no markdown) for 06_SCHEMA/141_corpse_found_secret_link.sql. Add to lucidota_control.corpse_event: ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.corpse_event ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS secrets_found_count integer DEFAULT 0; ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.corpse_event ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS secrets_filed boolean DEFAULT false; UPDATE the training_eligibility CHECK constraint: DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS corpse_event_training_eligibility_check; ADD CONSTRAINT corpse_event_training_eligibility_check CHECK(training_eligibility IN ('ELIGIBLE','SCRUB','REVIEW')) — where SCRUB means secrets were found and filed to found_secret, raw content must not enter training pipeline. Comment: SCRUB = secrets found+filed. Content archived in KRAMPUSCHEWING. Not for training.

label: schema-138-add-triple-redundancy
prompt: Read the existing content of /home/mfspx/LUCIDOTA/06_SCHEMA/138_worker_contract_versions.sql. Append (do not replace) the following to the file: ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.worker_contract_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contract_timestamp timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.worker_contract_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contract_version_seq integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1; COMMENT ON COLUMN lucidota_control.worker_contract_version.contract_hash IS 'SHA256 of contract fields — triple redundancy with contract_timestamp + contract_version_seq. Aircraft standard: hash catches content tampering, timestamp catches drift, seq catches ordering.'; Also add to job_contract_snapshot: ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.job_contract_snapshot ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contract_timestamp timestamptz; ALTER TABLE lucidota_control.job_contract_snapshot ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS contract_version_seq integer. Output ONLY the ALTER statements to append, not the full file.

label: update-krampus-retire-secrets

Add secret detection: before inserting the corpse_event, scan the file content for patterns matching secrets: API keys (sk-ant-, sk-, AKIA, gho_, ghp_), passwords (password=, passwd=, secret=), tokens (token=, bearer , Authorization:), connection strings (postgres://, mysql://), private key headers (-----BEGIN).
